items.title: 15.7.2 Use and Abuse of Drugs (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the use and abuse of drugs (PDF 48-49).

blocks.text: Use (istemal) ka matlab tibbi maqsad ke liye dawa ka munasib ya tajweez kardah istemal hai; abuse (ghalat istemal) aam taur par psychoactive drugs ka na-munasib istemal hai.

blocks.caption: Aam ghalat istemal hone wali psychoactive drugs
rows: afeem ke poday se opioid; injection, dhuan ya naak se
jald inhisar aur lat; saans ka dabna, infections, zehni bimariyan
Indian hemp, Cannabis sativa, ke sookhe phool, patte aur tana; dhuan, bhaap ya khane mein
sukoon, sarsoor, badla hua idraak, zyada bhook
soch mein kharabi, saans ke masail, zehni bimariyan
lat aur inhisar; saans ke masail, cancers, dil ki bimari, zehni bimariyan
soch aur harkat mein kharabi, jigar ki bimari, dil ki bimari, zehni bimariyan
nail polish remover, gond; soonghe jate
saans ke masail, soch mein kharabi, asabi nuqsan

blocks.text: Ghalat istemal ki withdrawal alamaat mein pareshani, udasi, thakan, be-chaini, mizaj ka utaar charhao, kapkapi, sar dard, paseena, matli, bhook ka khatam hona, be-khwabi, tez dharkan, high blood pressure, waham (nazar, sunne ya chhoone ke) aur dauray shamil hain.

blocks.prompt: Morphine ke use aur abuse mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Use: doctor shadeed dard ke liye naapi hui khuraak mein morphine tajweez karta hai. Abuse: tibbi zaroorat ke baghair sarsoor ke liye lena, jo inhisar aur lat tak le jata hai.

items: Use = tajweez kardah tibbi istemal; abuse = psychoactive drugs ka na-munasib istemal: heroin, cannabis, nicotine, alcohol, inhalants; withdrawal ki bohat si alamaat.
